title: What is the typical daily schedule during Mahotsav?

segments.text: During the Mahotsav, our schedule is designed to be deeply immersive yet very flexible. While none of the sessions are strictly mandatory, we strongly encourage you to participate in every session. It is a truly rare opportunity to connect face-to-face with Parikshit Bhaiya and your mentors, with whom you normally only interact virtually. Dedicated mantra chanting is the main focus of your stay. Taking time out of a busy life to spend 24 hours a day focused entirely on your sadhana is a priceless gift. To support your practice, a continuous, 24-hour havan will run throughout the event. You are welcome to join in at any time. Daily Highlights: ​Mornings: Mentors are available for open discussions before Bhaiya arrives, offering a quiet space to learn and receive profound spiritual knowledge. ​Afternoons & Day: Parikshit Bhaiya leads the havan, satsang, and bhajans, while also making personal time to meet visitors individually, check auras, and sharing deep spiritual insights. ​Evenings: After Bhaiya takes his leave, mentors step back in to host late-night, hands-on practice sessions focused on third eye development. ​Whether you spend your time chanting near the havan, working on your assigned sadhana, engaging with mentors, or offering seva (volunteer service), you are completely free to participate and rest at your own pace.
